recommended_requirement: MUST enforce per-action and cumulative limits, velocity, concurrency, delegation depth and execution budget.

recommended_requirement: MUST present material instruction details through a trusted UI or approved corporate signing channel for human approval; an agent-rendered summary cannot be the only evidence.

recommended_requirement: MUST evidence meaningful human review: exact object shown, reviewer entitlement, challenge, decision, time and signed receipt.
